Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

Locations: Bangalore / Mumbai / Delhi

Experience: 20+ Years

Function: Technology & Digital Transformation

Industry: SaaS / EdTech / B2B Technology

About the Role

  • We are looking for an accomplished Chief Technology Officer (CTO) with 20+ years of technology leadership experience to define and drive the organisation's technology vision, digital transformation and product engineering strategy.
  • The ideal candidate will be a strategic technology leader with a strong background in SaaS, EdTech or B2B technology, combining deep technical expertise with business acumen, product thinking and proven experience building high-performing technology organisations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the organisation's technology strategy and roadmap aligned with business and revenue objectives.
  • Lead the architecture, development, scalability and continuous evolution of SaaS and digital technology platforms.
  • Drive product engineering, technology innovation, automation and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Build, mentor and lead high-performing teams across engineering, product technology, DevOps, cloud, data and information security.
  • Establish scalable and secure technology architectures capable of supporting rapid business growth.
  • Drive cloud adoption, platform scalability, API integrations, data platforms and technology modernisation.
  • Ensure high standards of software quality, performance, availability, security and reliability.
  • Establish robust engineering practices covering SDLC, DevOps, CI/CD, testing, release management and technology governance.
  • Oversee cybersecurity, data privacy, risk management, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including AI/ML and automation, where they create measurable business value.
  • Partner closely with the CEO, business leadership, product and commercial teams to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
  • Manage technology budgets, vendors, strategic technology partners and external development relationships.
  • Establish technology KPIs and ensure predictable delivery, operational efficiency and continuous improvement.

Candidate Profile

  • 20+ years of overall technology experience, with significant experience in SaaS, EdTech, B2B technology or digital platforms.
  • Proven experience in a CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Technology or equivalent senior technology leadership role.
  • Strong track record of building and scaling technology teams and technology platforms.
  • Deep understanding of cloud architecture, SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, APIs, databases, cybersecurity and DevOps.
  • Experience taking technology products from strategy and architecture through development, deployment, scaling and optimisation.
  • Strong understanding of product engineering and the ability to balance technology excellence, speed, scalability and commercial priorities.
  • Demonstrated experience leading digital transformation and technology modernisation initiatives.
  • Strong business orientation with the ability to communicate effectively with CXOs, investors, customers and senior stakeholders.
  • Exceptional leadership, strategic thinking, problem-solving and stakeholder management capabilities.

Work Locations: Bangalore / Mumbai / Delhi

We're not looking for a figurehead. We're looking for a creative force who leads from the front, shapes culture from the inside out, and knows exactly what it takes to get great work made. As Group Creative Director, you will be the creative conscience of the agency, setting the standard not just by assigning work, but by understanding the work deeply enough to unblock it when it matters most.

This is a role for someone who has earned their stripes in agency life, understands the full machinery of creative delivery, and whose hands-on technical knowledge makes them a genuine resource to the people around them, not just a title above them.

Responsibilities

Be the Practical Problem-Solver the Team Needs

  • When the team hits a wall, you're the one who knows how to climb it. Whether it's a design execution challenge, a production constraint, a motion problem, or an AI workflow that isn't behaving, you can step in with a real, working solution rather than a theoretical one.
  • Your value in those moments comes from having actually done the work at some point, knowing the tools, understanding the process, and being able to show rather than just tell.
  • Identify creative and technical blockers early, and resolve them before they become delays or compromises in quality.
  • Establish ways of working that give the team clarity, reduce friction, and raise the floor on output.

Lead with Craft and Creative Authority

  • Set the visual and conceptual tone across campaigns, brands, and platforms.
  • Maintain a strong, consistent aesthetic point of view that elevates every piece of work that leaves the building.
  • Be the person in the room who can tell whether an idea is truly great, and articulate clearly and specifically why.

Think Strategically, Create Deliberately

  • Partner with strategy and account leadership to develop creative briefs that are sharp, provocative, and genuinely useful.
  • Translate brand positioning, audience insight, and business objectives into creative territory that is both distinctive and effective.
  • Anticipate client needs before they are articulated. Read between the lines of a brief and pre-empt creative pivots before they become problems.

Scope, Plan, and Protect the Work

  • Bring a grounded understanding of what it actually takes to execute ideas well, and use that to scope workstreams realistically and responsibly.
  • Identify early where a project might hit friction, whether creative, technical, or logistical, and resolve it upstream.
  • Build timelines and resource plans that protect quality without sacrificing pace.

Communicate with Clarity and Conviction

  • A sharp communicator both internally and externally, able to present ideas, navigate feedback, and align stakeholders with equal confidence.
  • A natural storyteller who can structure a narrative whether in a credentials deck, a pitch room, or an all-hands. The kind of person whose presentations people actually remember.
  • Skilled at reading a room and knowing when to push, when to reframe, and when something simply isn't working yet. Able to have those honest conversations with tact and without ambiguity.
  • Rally creative teams around a vision and give them the kind of direction that is specific enough to act on.

Build and Elevate the Creative Department

  • Mentor creative teams with specificity: not just what is wrong, but how to fix it and why it matters.
  • Create an environment where junior talent is challenged, developed, and retained.
  • Set the tone for creative culture: rigorous, curious, collaborative, and ambitious.

Own the AI Creative Frontier

  • Be the agency's lead practitioner and evangelist for AI in creative work. Fluent in generative image, video, copy, and audio tools, and always current with the evolving landscape.
  • Go beyond generation: architect AI-assisted workflows and production pipelines that meaningfully improve creative output, speed, and scale.
  • Identify where AI creates genuine creative opportunity versus where it compromises craft, and make those calls with authority.
  • Educate and upskill the creative department on AI tools, establishing shared standards for their ethical and effective use.
  • Collaborate with technology and production partners to design bespoke AI solutions for client challenges.

What You Bring

Experience

  • 15+ years in creative roles, with a significant portion spent in agency environments (integrated, digital, or brand).
  • Proven experience leading creative departments or large multi-disciplinary creative teams.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates range across brand, campaign, digital, and experiential, with a clear and ownable aesthetic sensibility.
  • Industry award recognition is a strong differentiator and speaks to a consistent standard of creative ambition. Shortlists, wins, and a culture of entering work are all signals we take seriously.

Hard Skills and Technical Range

  • Genuine proficiency across the tools and disciplines relevant to modern creative production: design, art direction, motion, digital, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Enough technical depth in each area to diagnose problems, propose solutions, and demonstrate them when needed.
  • Not expected to execute every deliverable day-to-day, but absolutely expected to know how, and to use that knowledge to make the team sharper.

Creative and Strategic Capability

  • A thinker and a maker in equal measure, able to move between strategic framework and craft-level execution without losing quality at either end.
  • Strong design instincts and visual literacy, equally comfortable directing photography, motion, digital design, and emerging formats.
  • The ability to hold a brand truth and a big idea simultaneously, and translate both into work that resonates.

AI Proficiency

  • Active, working knowledge of leading generative AI tools (image, video, language, audio): not surface-level familiarity, but genuine hands-on expertise.
  • Experience designing or implementing AI into creative and production workflows.
  • An informed, evolving perspective on where AI is heading and what it means for the creative industry.

Communication and Storytelling

  • Exceptional presenter and communicator, comfortable in the boardroom, the pitch, and the internal critique with equal conviction.
  • A natural instinct for narrative: how to structure a story, build tension, land a point, and leave a room energised.
  • Direct, clear, and credible in the way they give feedback and manage expectations.

The Kind of Person You Are

  • You don't just have taste, you can articulate it. You don't just delegate, you demonstrate. You're not threatened by AI; you're ahead of it. You've sat in enough pitches to know when an idea is campaign-ready and when it's still a sketch, and you're not afraid to say so clearly, even when it's uncomfortable.
  • You know the difference between a production problem and a creative problem. You know when a brief is actually good. You've done the work yourself long enough to know exactly where teams get stuck, and you show up to those moments with practical answers, not just encouragement.
  • You believe that craft and speed are not opposites. That strategy and beauty belong together. And that the best creative leaders are the ones still learning.

Why This Role

This is a genuine leadership position with real creative authority, not a bureaucratic title. You'll work on brands that matter, alongside people who care deeply about what they make. The agency is at an inflection point, investing seriously in AI capability, new creative formats, and a more integrated way of working. You'll help define what that looks like.

Good to have skills : Amazon Web Services (AWS), Snowflake Data Warehouse, Microsoft Azure Data Services
Minimum
18 year(s) of experience is required

AI Powered Tech Talent

As a senior AI/ML Computational Scientist, you will design, build, and operationalize artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for enterprise clients, combining custom models with cloud and third-party AI services to deliver production-ready outcomes. Your role spans the full solution lifecycle assessing client needs and data, selecting and customizing models (including Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models), designing scalable data and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for training and production, and ensuring quality, value, and reliability of deployed systems.
Formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions
Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, models, and computational systems design and build scalable data pipelines to support model training and production with DevOps MLOps
Customize and apply Deep Learning and Gen AI models for various use cases based on the business needs, data availability, system and infrastructure requirements - including edge device and HPC
Engage in research and development of new AI and high-performance compute algorithms, models, and simulations along with their applications to solve complex business problems at client sites
Work with large-scale datasets and utilize data preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality input for training and production
Implement and maintain efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms for models and knowledge using appropriate tools
Justify the value of model approaches in business problems
Collaborate with teams from both business and technical sides, including users, use case representatives, business owners, engineers, architects, and UI designers, to achieve end-to-end project goals and integrate into production
Bachelor''s Degree or equivalent
Minimum of 7 years of experience as a machine learning engineer or scientist, deploying models in production at scale , including monitoring, alerting, automatic bug filing and auditing.
Minimum of 7 years of experience in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming
Minimum of 5 years of experience in distributed computing systems and architecture that may include big data, high-performance compute, engineering simulations, scientific compute, grid and cloud computing, distributed networks
Minimum of 4 years of experience in building and deploying AI/ML based software to a cloud environment.
Proficiency in Python and python-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)..
Experience working with language models like LLM''s APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications.
Experience with the following programming languages: Python, C++, Java, R, SQL
Strong written verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Strong client-facing skillsets in a consulting environment
Strong cross-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client-side teams
Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation
MS or PhD in related field preferred (computer science, engineering, etc.)

Make and defend the business case for the semantic layer solution at the executive level.
Lead Accenture sales and pre-sales efforts and shape data transformation programs.
Drive the practice''s thought leadership, innovation, and asset development on trends and agentic technologies, and develop the teams who deliver them.
Bachelor''s degree or equivalent

Minimum 6 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies (RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL)

Minimum 3 years of experience with end-to-end data pipeline implementations for AI applications (esp. LLMs), with hands-on design and configuration
Minimum 6 years of experience with strong knowledge of relational databases, object stores, graph databases (Stardog, Neo4J, Amazon Neptune), and vector databases

Experience in Practical experience with NLP techniques and/or Search Techniques, prompt engineering

5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)

Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across engineering, research, and product teams across multiple time zones.

Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
